inputs.text: [excited] PEN… tah… SEH… rah… tops. [curious] "Penta," in Greek, means five. "Cerat" is horn. And "ops" is face.
[happily] Almost: three real horns, [pauses] plus two bony points on his cheeks. [warmly] He lived in New Mexico, in North America, seventy-five million years ago.
[nervous] Did he have enemies out there?
